### <span class="imp imp-high" title="Importance 7/10" aria-label="Importance 7 of 10">7</span> Anthropic integrates Claude into Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>Claude for Google Workspace launched October 6, 2026 in public beta</li>
<li>Available to all paid Claude plan subscribers</li>
<li>Claude can edit Docs without altering surrounding formatting</li>
</ul>

## AI Models

### <span class="imp imp-high" title="Importance 7/10" aria-label="Importance 7 of 10">7</span> New AI model releases: GPT-6.1 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5
OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Sol on September 29 as a cost-effective coding orchestrator, while Anthropic launched Claude Opus 5.5 on September 22 for long-horizon agentic work. Both models offer expanded context windows and demonstrate early breakthroughs in multi-step reasoning and code migration tasks.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>GPT-6.1 Sol: 1,050,000-token input, 128,000-token output; $2/$10 per million tokens</li>
<li>Matches GPT-6 Astra performance at one-fifth the cost on DeepSWE v1.1 benchmark</li>
<li>Claude Opus 5.5: 1,000,000-token context, 128,000-token output (expandable to 300,000 via Batch API)</li>
<li>Early testers completed 680,000-line code migration in under a day with Claude Opus 5.5</li>
</ul>

Sources: [BASENOR](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxOMkhsWjVQc0Nib0RlZ09wSmhKNnpSLU00Q1JHX0NkM3N5SWZ6STNEclVVWjJSdGFTUUdaMWFWRWhRWFFIWVlGbkNIWExxbTBKOXY4VkNNNnhLc0NGTnZpbTJfUkVTVmd5NmVwVVljeUpHTTh4aXhKOWs2WURwWVdaYi13S2J4aTgwRlZSQTVGbXdsVmh6UjNaTG92UFBFZw?oc=5) <span class="src-badge src-research">AI Web Searched</span>

### <span class="imp imp-mid" title="Importance 6/10" aria-label="Importance 6 of 10">6</span> Anthropic grants Claude access to red teams and verified cyber defenders
Anthropic loosened restrictions on Claude to allow verified cybersecurity professionals and red teams to access the model for defensive purposes.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>Three tiers: Defense Access, Red Team Access, Specialized Access</li>
<li>Models: Claude Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Mythos 5.1 with reduced safeguards</li>
<li>Defense Access: security teams, nonprofits, universities, government, critical infrastructure, researchers</li>
<li>Red Team Access: in-house, government, and penetration testing firms; ineligible for individuals</li>
<li>Specialized Access: vetted organizations testing power grids, flight systems, telecom, banking infrastructure</li>
</ul>
